name: photos
description: The Photos section's navigation: show timeline / albums / explore, open search, back. Reached by: app go_to photos.

actions.name: back
actions.description: Back one page, as the page's back button does. Not at home

actions.name: search
actions.description: Open photo search, as the search button does. Home only

actions.name: show
actions.description: Show a sub-tab (timeline, albums, explore), as the segmented control does. Home only

page.description: The page shown: home (the sub-tabs), album, search, section (one Explore list) or filtered (a timeline opened from Explore) or album_rules (a new dynamic album's rules)

mode.description: The sub-tab of home (kept while another page is on top)

title.description: The album, section or filtered timeline's title; null at home and in search

albumId.description: The album shown, on an album page

depth.description: Pages stacked, home included: back goes down one
